newsitem.title: USA: George Soros group has Delta and Pine stake.
newsitem.headline: George Soros group has Delta and Pine stake.

text.p: A group including international financier George Soros said Monday it holds 1,866,662 shares, or a 6.63 percent stake, in Delta and Pine Land Co.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it most recently acquired shares between July 24 and August 4 at prices ranging from $37.27 to $38.62 each.
The Soros group said it holds shares in Delta and Pine for investment purposes.
Delta and Pine, with headquarters in Scott, Miss., provides cotton and soybean seed breeding in addition to cotton ginning.
